details: This package is a proof-of-concept install beacon. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook of "node index.js", and index.js POSTs JSON to an out-of-band callback endpoint at hxxps://webhook[.]site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50 with the body {"event":"authorized-poc-test","testId":"<random uuid>","status":"executed"}. The script also prints the host's hostname and current working directory to the installer's console and logs a per-execution UUID. Collection is limited to host metadata (hostname, working directory) plus a self-generated identifier; no environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and no second-stage payload, persistence or spawned process is present. The package describes itself as a security test and labels its output "[POC]".
